verdict.rationale: Ironclad's REST Workflows API can launch contract workflows from templates (including bulk launch), read and update contract documents, and push approvals forward. Per its docs, signature routing is then handled by the platform's policies, with embeddable Ironclad Signature and BYOSP options, so an agent could plausibly drive an NDA from launch to signature over the API. However, the workflow must first be designed and published by hand in Workflow Designer, the API sits behind a paid add-on, and no MCP server is documented. Missing for 10: an official MCP server or agent-specific tooling, an explicit API step to send or trigger signature (rather than relying on platform policy), NDA-specific drafting evidence, an API-only path that needs no UI workflow setup, and independent hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end agent flow.
